latestVersion.changelog:
aws-emr-skills 2.0.0 — Major update with unified management and new features across all EMR modes.

- Adds support for managing and submitting jobs to EMR Serverless, EMR on EC2, and EMR on EKS.
- Enables submission and lifecycle management for Spark, Hive, and PySpark jobs across all deployment modes.
- New tools for listing clusters, steps, applications, and virtual clusters, retrieving job and step logs, and handling results from S3.
- Adds robust credential handling and log masking for improved security.
- Provides detailed user guides and setup documentation for all supported EMR workflows.
